page.layout: One column of running text, full width. Page number at the top left. Running head at the top, partly covered by a dark mark. No marginal notes. Small "»" marks stand at the start of each line in the left margin, and a small mark at the right margin beside the line "quod".

main_text.l: lio eius, quæ ante partū me-
retrix fuit, certum est: an ea-
est: quia ex hac natus, & hæc
scriptum est, Bis de eadem re
ne fit actio: id est, hoc Bis ad

page.notes: The page number reads "180" as printed, though the first digit is blurred. The running head is covered by a dark stamp and cannot be read. The "»" marks at the start of each line are probably printed line ornaments, so I left them out. "huncsta" at the line end continues "tum" on the next line without a printed hyphen; I joined it as "huncstatum", which is a likely reading, not certain. The printed "û" and "ũ" are kept as printed. The text is one paragraph because no line is indented on this page.
